svg.title: Planetary Boundaries — Interactive Scientific Visualization
svg.desc: Interactive visualization of the nine planetary boundaries and their scientific control variables, showing environmental pressure relative to the Safe Operating Space. Source artwork is preserved; the topic.earth controller provides dated assessments and an explicitly threshold-aligned scientific display and linear illustrative controls.

metadata.tpNotes: Legacy source artwork uses a present-day envelope; its original rectangle extents are not scientific normalization. The current controller uses a fixed green-boundary reference at q=1 and a separate outer visual cap. Scientific data, ranges and reference-relative normalization are versioned outside the SVG. Each known high-risk threshold maps to a common second visual ring; that ring is not a universal physical ratio.
metadata.scientificBasis: Richardson et al. (2023), Science Advances, published 2023-09-13, DOI 10.1126/sciadv.adh2458; selected Planetary Health Check assessment. Default: Planetary Health Check 2026, published 2026-09-21, DOI 10.48485/pik.2026.25. Historical snapshots retain their own values and methods.
metadata.attribution: Original user-provided SVG: original artwork authorship and license not established. Scientific sources: Richardson et al.; Planetary Boundaries Science (PBScience), Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research. PHC report art and figures credit Globaïa. topic.earth adaptation does not claim scientific research or third-party artwork ownership or endorsement. PHC figures CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise noted; Richardson article CC BY-NC 4.0. Verify source artwork rights before redistribution.
